summary: Tested initial-based avatar implementation in Trinity ticket conversation view. All avatar features working correctly: initials extraction, deterministic color assignment from on-brand palette, proper message alignment, and avatar styling.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test tickets TKT-021071 and TKT-000975
context_for_next_testing_agent: Avatar implementation is complete and working. All test cases passed for: multi-word names (Atlas Agent -> AA, Nikita C -> NC), single names (Rohit -> R), email addresses (john.doe@email.com -> JD), deterministic color hashing from 8-color on-brand palette.

features_tested.details: getInitials function correctly handles: multi-word names (First+Last initial), single names (First letter), email addresses (extracts initials from local part before @), edge cases (empty, null, spaced names)
Same sender always gets same color via hash function. Found 4+ unique colors from the 8-color palette: Cyan (#0891b2), Amber (#d97706), Teal (#0d9488), Indigo (#6366f1)
All avatar colors from curated AVATAR_PALETTE harmonizing with brand teal (#00A1B2): Cyan, Blue, Indigo, Violet, Teal, Emerald, Amber, Rose
Customer messages left-aligned (mr-auto), Agent replies right-aligned (ml-auto). Internal notes would be center-aligned (mx-auto) but none found in test tickets
Avatar is 24x24px circular (border-radius: 9999px), 10px font for initials, proper contrast between text color and semi-transparent background
TKT-021071 loaded with 78 messages and avatars, TKT-000975 loaded with 2 messages. No errors during load

test_cases_verified: Nikita C -> NC (multi-word name with single letter last name)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A - No issues found. Avatar implementation is complete and working as expected.
